headline.purpose: Large identity statement in the access panel.

label.purpose: Field labels and semibold control text.

shadows.name: pdf-page
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation around each page in the document preview.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main form action for sign-in and invitation acceptance.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--color-institutional); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--color-institutional); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font: 650 0.93rem/1.55 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--color-institutional-dark); background: var(--color-institutional-dark); } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6e0000; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled text entry for access forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 600 0.93rem/1.55 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid #8b8990; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1rem/1.55 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #5e5b64; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-institutional); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(164 0 0 / 18%); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6e0000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary shell action such as signing out or retrying.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #720000; cursor: pointer; font: 650 0.9rem/1.4 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { border-color: #d9b9b9; background: #fbf5f5; } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6e0000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Responsive workspace navigation with an explicit active marker.
components.html: Cartas
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 22px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 2px; color: var(--color-muted); font: 600 0.94rem/1.4 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-institutional); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--color-institutional); content: ''; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6e0000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Notice
components.description: Compact error or information message in access and workspace flows.
components.html: Tu cuenta está lista. Inicia sesión para continuar.
components.css: .ds-notice { margin: 0 0 22px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 7px; font: 400 0.92rem/1.5 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-notice--info { background: var(--color-info-ground); color: var(--color-info); } .ds-notice--error { background: var(--color-error-ground); color: var(--color-error); }

components.name: Compact Editor Field
components.description: Labeled structured metadata entry in the document editor.
components.css: .ds-editor-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 600 0.85rem/1.55 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-editor-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid #9b999e; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 0.9rem/1.55 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-editor-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-institutional); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(164 0 0 / 18%); outline: none; } .ds-editor-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6e0000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace Save Button
components.description: Explicit save action for a synchronized academic letter draft.
components.css: .ds-workspace-save { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 17px; border: 1px solid var(--color-institutional); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--color-institutional); color: var(--color-paper); cursor: pointer; font: 650 0.93rem/1.55 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-workspace-save:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--color-institutional-dark); background: var(--color-institutional-dark); } .ds-workspace-save:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-workspace-save:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6e0000; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-workspace-save:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Document Editor Panel
components.description: White bordered container for editor fields or PDF preview.
components.html:
Datos de la carta

Contenido del espacio de trabajo
components.css: .ds-editor-panel { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-editor-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 1.07rem/1.4 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-editor-panel p { color: var(--color-muted); font: 400 0.9rem/1.55 'Onest Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The established T11 access and navigation system and shipped T12 document-editor extension use a clear institutional frame: a broad red identity field beside a quiet white form, followed after sign-in by a light workspace shell. The editor reuses the workspace palette, Onest typography, focus treatment, and restrained geometry, adding compact metadata fields, paired authoring and preview panels, and a narrow-screen edit/preview switch. The supplied SCESI and university marks remain the authority for institutional identity; the application adds only a small crossing-line pennant cue.

These editor details describe the current implementation rather than a durable redesign. Broader visual refinement remains open for later manual work.
keyCharacteristics: Institutional red anchors identity, actions, and active navigation.
Warm gray grounds the workspace; white carries focused content.
Crisp geometry and restrained borders keep the interface direct.

rules.name: The Identity Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve institutional red for identity, primary actions, and clear active or hover states; keep ordinary workspace surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Use the distinct error and information pairs for notices, not as general decoration.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Onest Variable throughout this surface; rely on size, weight, and spacing for hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use surface color and fine separators for structure; reserve the soft ring for an actively focused field.

dos: Do use the institutional red token for primary actions and active navigation.
Do keep form surfaces white against the warm-gray workspace ground.
Do retain clear labels, visible keyboard focus, and the responsive stacking behavior.
Do use only approved SCESI and UMSS marks when an institutional mark is needed.
donts: Don't recreate the academic PDF header in application chrome.
Don't add emoji or substitute glyph icons for the approved icon approach.
Don't treat the current implementation as a final visual settlement; broader refinement remains open for later manual work.
